mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS conversationId, CASE WHEN c.user1_id = #{me} THEN c.user2_id ELSE c.user1_id END AS peerId, c.product_id AS productId, c.last_message_id AS lastId, m.content AS lastContent, COALESCE(m.create_time, c.last_time) AS lastTime, COALESCE(unread.unreadCount, 0) AS unreadCount, u.nickname AS peerNickname, u.username AS peerUsername, u.avatar AS peerAvatar FROM conversation c LEFT JOIN message m ON c.last_message_id = m.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT from_user_id AS peerId, COUNT(*) AS unreadCount FROM message WHERE to_user_id = #{me} AND is_read = 0 GROUP BY from_user_id ) unread ON unread.peerId = CASE WHEN c.user1_id = #{me} THEN c.user2_id ELSE c.user1_id END LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = CASE WHEN c.user1_id = #{me} THEN c.user2_id ELSE c.user1_id END WHERE c.user1_id = #{me} OR c.user2_id = #{me} ORDER BY c.last_time DESC, c.id DESC
